# `.github/` in this repo

This folder only holds one thing now: [`workflows/ci.yml`](workflows/ci.yml)
— the syntax check + smoke test that run on every PR.

**Project governance moved (2026-09-21).** The roadmap, to-do list,
history, known blockers, and API research used to live in this folder —
they now live in the org's actual governance hub, since they cover both
`msv-web` and `msv-api`, not just this repo:

👉 **[github.com/Maximising-Shareholder-Value/.github](https://github.com/Maximising-Shareholder-Value/.github)**

(Yes, that repo is also named `.github` — it's GitHub's special org-wide
defaults repo, repurposed as the project's PMO hub. See that repo's own
`CLAUDE.md` for why.)

For this repo's own technical reference (how the code works, data-source
quirks, config/secrets setup), see [`../CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) instead
— that hasn't moved.
